title: 移动边界刷子与 pull 抽取把手
notes: 本轮继续把规则当作公理，目标是产出两组可供 designer 使用的局部语料： B/S 锚点作为可移动切割线如何在不移动远处物体的情况下重写资源拓扑； P/L pull 侧如何按对象 footprint 与侧向余量形成抽取、卡住或扫带结构。

cases.variant: 边界下刷：横条整行释放
cases.changedVariable: 基准：水平边界下移一格，完整覆盖 2 格横条所在行
把横条改为跨越两行的竖条，边界只覆盖上半格
把竖条尾部扩成横向 L 底，切割线只释放上颈
把垂直下刷改为沿边界方向横移，边界行不跨过对象

cases.variant: 边界上刷：两行资源绑定成 2x2
cases.changedVariable: 边界上移一格，把上行 crate 纳入 sticky 侧并与下行 sticky 正交连接

cases.variant: 边界上刷：隔列保留两个柱状工具
cases.changedVariable: 在上刷绑定基准中加入一列间隙，阻止两个柱合并为大块
基准：pull 前格空、身后单格 crate
保留身后 crate，但把玩家前格换成墙
cases.returnToInitial: not applicable: replay stopped at illegal action; return search skipped

cases.changedVariable: 把身后单 crate 换成沿 pull 轴排列的 B/S 二格物体

cases.variant: 竖向锚点需要侧向余量
cases.changedVariable: 把 B/S 二格物体转为垂直 footprint，并开放下半格的目标位

cases.variant: 侧向目标墙封死竖向抽取
cases.changedVariable: 保持玩家前格开放，但堵住垂直锚点下半格的目标位
cases.returnToInitial: not applicable: replay stopped at illegal action; return search skipped

cases.changedVariable: 把侧向目标墙换成可移动 crate，抽取时同步扫走侧箱

cases.variant: 边界下刷：横条整行释放
cases.changedVariable: 基准：水平边界下移一格，完整覆盖 2 格横条所在行
cases.question: 移动 B/S 边界而不移动远处对象，把一个 sticky 横条整行回收为两个 crate。

winCondition.description: After movement, box/sticky normalization, and sticky merging settle, every target must be covered by a crate, sticky block cell, or anchor cell. The player standing on a target does not count.

cases.changedVariable: 把横条改为跨越两行的竖条，边界只覆盖上半格
cases.question: 同样下刷一格，竖条被改写为 crate 头部和 sticky 尾部，适合制造部分释放债。

winCondition.description: After movement, box/sticky normalization, and sticky merging settle, every target must be covered by a crate, sticky block cell, or anchor cell. The player standing on a target does not count.

cases.changedVariable: 把竖条尾部扩成横向 L 底，切割线只释放上颈
cases.question: 切割 L 形上颈时，释放出的 crate 头与保留的 sticky 尾构成不同后续资源形态。

winCondition.description: After movement, box/sticky normalization, and sticky merging settle, every target must be covered by a crate, sticky block cell, or anchor cell. The player standing on a target does not count.

cases.changedVariable: 把垂直下刷改为沿边界方向横移，边界行不跨过对象
cases.question: 沿边界方向搬运 B/S 锚点时，远处 sticky 横条保持为刚体债，可作为延迟切割的调位结构。

winCondition.description: After movement, box/sticky normalization, and sticky merging settle, every target must be covered by a crate, sticky block cell, or anchor cell. The player standing on a target does not count.

cases.variant: 边界上刷：两行资源绑定成 2x2
cases.changedVariable: 边界上移一格，把上行 crate 纳入 sticky 侧并与下行 sticky 正交连接
cases.question: 移动边界线也能把未移动的 crate 行压进既有 sticky 行，形成一个 2x2 刚体工具。

winCondition.description: After movement, box/sticky normalization, and sticky merging settle, every target must be covered by a crate, sticky block cell, or anchor cell. The player standing on a target does not count.

cases.variant: 边界上刷：隔列保留两个柱状工具
cases.changedVariable: 在上刷绑定基准中加入一列间隙，阻止两个柱合并为大块
cases.question: 同样上刷绑定两行资源，列间隙会保留两个独立柱状工具，而不是一个 2x2 刚体。

winCondition.description: After movement, box/sticky normalization, and sticky merging settle, every target must be covered by a crate, sticky block cell, or anchor cell. The player standing on a target does not count.

cases.changedVariable: 基准：pull 前格空、身后单格 crate
cases.question: P/L pull 侧提供一个抽取把手：玩家离开对象，crate 填入玩家旧格。

winCondition.description: After movement, box/sticky normalization, and sticky merging settle, every target must be covered by a crate, sticky block cell, or anchor cell. The player standing on a target does not count.

cases.changedVariable: 保留身后 crate，但把玩家前格换成墙
cases.question: 对象就在身后也不够；pull 抽取需要玩家先能离开，前格墙把抽取把手关闭。

winCondition.description: After movement, box/sticky normalization, and sticky merging settle, every target must be covered by a crate, sticky block cell, or anchor cell. The player standing on a target does not count.

returnToInitial.reason: replay stopped at illegal action; return search skipped

cases.changedVariable: 把身后单 crate 换成沿 pull 轴排列的 B/S 二格物体
cases.question: 沿抽取轴排列的二格物体可通过一格前进空间完成整体抽取，适合当作长把手或移动边界。

winCondition.description: After movement, box/sticky normalization, and sticky merging settle, every target must be covered by a crate, sticky block cell, or anchor cell. The player standing on a target does not count.

cases.variant: 竖向锚点需要侧向余量
cases.changedVariable: 把 B/S 二格物体转为垂直 footprint，并开放下半格的目标位
cases.question: 垂直 footprint 的抽取不仅需要玩家前格，还需要侧向半格能同步平移。

winCondition.description: After movement, box/sticky normalization, and sticky merging settle, every target must be covered by a crate, sticky block cell, or anchor cell. The player standing on a target does not count.

cases.variant: 侧向目标墙封死竖向抽取
cases.changedVariable: 保持玩家前格开放，但堵住垂直锚点下半格的目标位
cases.question: 竖向 footprint 的失败可以来自侧向目标位，而不是玩家前格；这给 designer 一个独立墙格门。

winCondition.description: After movement, box/sticky normalization, and sticky merging settle, every target must be covered by a crate, sticky block cell, or anchor cell. The player standing on a target does not count.

cases.changedVariable: 把侧向目标墙换成可移动 crate，抽取时同步扫走侧箱
cases.question: 侧向目标位不是只能开或堵；放入可移动资源时，抽取动作会变成带走侧箱的扫带结构。

winCondition.description: After movement, box/sticky normalization, and sticky merging settle, every target must be covered by a crate, sticky block cell, or anchor cell. The player standing on a target does not count.
